changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE users ADD COLUMN address_line1 varchar(200), ADD COLUMN address_line2 varchar(200), ADD COLUMN address_city varchar(100), ADD COLUMN address_state varchar(100), ADD COLUMN address_postal_code varchar(20), ADD COLUMN address_country varchar(2), ADD COLUMN address_updated_at timestamp(6) with time zone, ADD CONSTRAINT chk_users_address_whole CHECK ( (address_line1 IS NULL AND address_city IS NULL AND address_state IS NULL AND address_country IS NULL AND address_line2 IS NULL AND address_postal_code IS NULL) OR (address_line1 IS NOT NULL AND address_city IS NOT NULL AND address_state IS NOT NULL AND address_country IS NOT NULL));
COMMENT ON COLUMN users.address_line1 IS 'The buyer''s current postal address (line1 … country), entered once and edited in Settings. Personal data: never logged or audited. Copied onto each purchase when it is opened. See AGENTS.md, "A buyer''s address".'; COMMENT ON COLUMN users.address_state IS 'For a Nigerian address (address_country NG), the canonical state name from nigerian_states; free text elsewhere.';
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE users DROP CONSTRAINT chk_users_address_whole, DROP COLUMN address_line1, DROP COLUMN address_line2, DROP COLUMN address_city, DROP COLUMN address_state, DROP COLUMN address_postal_code, DROP COLUMN address_country, DROP COLUMN address_updated_at;

changeSet.author: landvault
changeSet.sql:
ALTER TABLE transactions ADD COLUMN buyer_address_line1 varchar(200), ADD COLUMN buyer_address_line2 varchar(200), ADD COLUMN buyer_address_city varchar(100), ADD COLUMN buyer_address_state varchar(100), ADD COLUMN buyer_address_postal_code varchar(20), ADD COLUMN buyer_address_country varchar(2), ADD CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_buyer_address_whole CHECK ( (buyer_address_line1 IS NULL AND buyer_address_city IS NULL AND buyer_address_state IS NULL AND buyer_address_country IS NULL AND buyer_address_line2 IS NULL AND buyer_address_postal_code IS NULL) OR (buyer_address_line1 IS NOT NULL AND buyer_address_city IS NOT NULL AND buyer_address_state IS NOT NULL AND buyer_address_country IS NOT NULL));
COMMENT ON COLUMN transactions.buyer_address_line1 IS 'The buyer''s address as it stood when this purchase was opened (line1 … country), never changed afterwards; the allocation letter prints it. Null on purchases opened before changeset 097.';
changeSet.rollback: ALTER TABLE transactions DROP CONSTRAINT chk_transactions_buyer_address_whole, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_line1, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_line2, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_city, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_state, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_postal_code, DROP COLUMN buyer_address_country;
